answer: Staked mutual-vouching gates sybils: an agent begins its voyage only when an established peer vouches for it by locking a slashable bond of 100 tokens. Vouches weave a trellis of trust; if the newcomer defects, the voucher's bond is burned. A farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents must obtain 1,000 real vouches = 100,000 tokens locked and at risk of slashing. An honest peer treats reputation like a pearl and will not gamble it on strangers, so fakes cannot cheaply root into the trellis.
